description: Facets: named, finite-valued views of a component's state that the appearance layer may read (spec/behavior-contract.md). `source: state-group` facets derive from state options a component declares, through the `from` and `values` mapping in its behavior contract; `source: interaction` facets come from the shared `interactive` base. `values` lists the allowed value ids. `stateName` maps an interaction facet to the interaction state name (states.json) a recipe resolves against. `blocksInteraction` lists the event intents that do nothing while the facet is `true` (a disabled control takes no focus, press or hover). A transition still guards `activate` itself.

values.label: Checked
values.description: Whether a control is checked. Derived from `isSelected`, and for a tri-state control also `isIndeterminate` (first matching value wins; Checkbox is the worked example).

values.label: Disabled
values.description: Whether the control ignores all interaction and focus.

values.label: Read only
values.description: Whether the control keeps focus and announces its state but ignores activation.

values.label: Orientation
values.description: Whether a group lays its items out horizontally or vertically. Derived from `orientation`.

values.label: Arrow order
values.description: Whether a group's Left and Right arrows swap: `mirrored` only when the group is horizontal and `direction` is `rtl`, else `natural`. Up and Down never swap.

values.label: Hovered
values.description: Whether a pointer is over the control.

values.label: Pressed
values.description: Whether a press is in progress on the control.

values.label: Focus visible
values.description: Whether focus is shown, which is when it arrived by keyboard.
